# Good Boy (2025 Leonberg film) — verification and sourcing status (as of 11 December 2025)

## Summary of findings

No independent, reliable sources could be identified that confirm the existence of a distinct 2025 film titled Good Boy associated with “Leonberg” (as a place, company, festival, or surname). Systematic checks of core German film industry databases and funding registers, major international trade publications, regional media in Baden-Württemberg, and review aggregators did not return a verifiable entry matching a 2025 release called Good Boy tied to Leonberg. The title Good Boy is shared by multiple unrelated films from other years and countries, including a 2003 U.S. family film, a 2020 Hulu/Blumhouse television feature, and a 2022 Norwegian thriller that received 2023 international coverage; none are associated with Leonberg or a 2025 release year . “Leonberg” is the name of a town in the district of Böblingen, Baden-Württemberg, which hosts the Traumpalast Leonberg multiplex, but there is no evidence that a 2025 film titled Good Boy originated from, was produced by, or premiered as a Leonberg-specific project .

Given the absence of coverage in authoritative databases (Filmportal.de; German Federal Film Board FFA) and trade press (Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, Screen Daily, Deadline) and the lack of listings on review aggregators (Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic) for a 2025 Leonberg-linked film of this title, notability and even existence cannot be substantiated as of 11 December 2025 . To avoid conflation with other similarly titled works, this report documents the verification steps taken and the relevant context.

 - Good Boy (2022), a Norwegian thriller by Viljar Bøe that received 2023 international release and reviews in trade press and is listed on review aggregators . None of these sources indicate any connection to Leonberg or a 2025 German production.

- “Leonberg” disambiguation: Leonberg is a town in Baden-Württemberg, Germany, with an official municipal portal and a prominent multiplex cinema, Traumpalast Leonberg . ## Development and production (unverified)

- Funding registers checked:
 - MFG Baden-Württemberg Film Funding (for development/production support in the state encompassing Leonberg) did not present an identifiable 2024–2025 entry for a project titled Good Boy associated with Leonberg during the period examined .
 - The German Federal Film Board (FFA) film database did not yield an identifiable entry for such a project .

- Post-production: No credible information on editing, sound post, or scoring for a Leonberg-linked 2025 Good Boy was located .

## Release and distribution (unverified)

- Festival premiere: No listing for a 2025 Leonberg-linked Good Boy was found in major trade outlets’ festival reporting or searchable archives .

- Theatrical release: No German or international theatrical release plan, distributor announcement, or cinema programming note could be located for a 2025 film of this title tied to Leonberg; the Traumpalast Leonberg cinema site shows no public-facing archive that attributes a 2025 premiere of Good Boy to a Leonberg-origin project during the period checked .

- Streaming and home media: No SVOD/TVOD/AVOD or physical media listings were identified for such a 2025 film .

## Reception and impact (unverified)

- Critical reception: Neither Rotten Tomatoes nor Metacritic shows a page for a 2025 Leonberg-linked Good Boy as of 11 December 2025; existing entries and coverage pertain to other Good Boy titles from different years/countries .

- Box office: No box office reporting was found for a 2025 film titled Good Boy connected to Leonberg .

- Controversies: No commentary or controversy specific to a 2025 Leonberg-linked Good Boy was identified in reputable outlets .

- Box office: Budget (if disclosed), domestic/international gross with source citations.

- Home media: Streaming and physical media release details.

Each section should cite independent, reliable sources; avoid primary-only sourcing where secondary coverage is available.

Wir binden Videos von YouTube ein, um z.B. bei Filmen auch den zugehörigen Trailer präsentieren zu können. Dies erfolgt i.d.R. in einem datenschutzkonformen Modus, bei dem sich YouTube auf die wesentlichen Cookies beschränkt.

 

- [x]  Vimeo-Videos
Wir binden teilweise Videos von Vimeo ein, um für besondere Filme auch den zugehörigen Trailer präsentieren zu können.

Um eine Routenplanung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu ermöglichen, binden wir die Fahrplanauskunft der VVS ein.

- [x]  Webstatistik Matomo
Wir verwenden für eine erweiterte anonymisierte statistische Erfassung von Zugriffen auf unsere Angebote die datenschutzfreundliche und auf unseren eigenen Systemen bereitgestellte Software Matomo (ehemals Piwik).

 

- [x]  Affiliate Marketing
Wir verlinken auf externe Angebot (z.B. Webshops für Bücher) und erhalten bei Kauf eines Produkts über diesen Link eine kleine Provision. Damit das erfasst werden kann, findet über die Firma AWIN AG ein Tracking mittels Awin-Domain-Cookies statt.
